headline: Names a post office in Florence, Arizona, after Adolfo "Harpo" Celaya.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 501 North Main Street in Florence, Arizona, as the "Adolfo 'Harpo' Celaya Post Office." It is a naming change only. It does not change postal services, hours, staffing, or mail rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2016.
